title: See you guys in the Steam:Popular New Releases Charts Soon!
author: Trashy_io

comments.author: goatanuss
comments.body:
An RTS where the combat is a card battle. That would take longer than a game of CiV to play let alone build

That’s pretty good but would honestly probably be pretty fun if you could get all the systems to have cohesion.

It makes me wonder if that woman who wanted to make a [science based dragon mmo](https://www.reddit.com/r/gaming/s/ry6TRGBqFU) has looked into AI. She could probably actually realize her idea now if she dedicated some time to it

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: agreed but it was just a parody post about how we can get a bit over scoped sometimes as a AI game dev just made it for a laugh!

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: man you guys really downvoting a comedic post? The vibe coding guys could at least take a joke!

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: I am an advocate for AI! But we all been here at one point no shame lol
